title: Bikaner coal mining & washeries: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
**Coal washing takes raw coal, crushes and beneficiates it, and sells washed coal to power, cement and sponge-iron buyers; mining services move overburden and coal for mine owners.** Cash comes in on offtake and grade realisation, not on tonnes dug. The rating file on a coal washery shows the cash trap: suppliers are paid in advance while customers take around 45-60 days to pay, so working capital bank lines carry the cycle [8]. **So when a proposal lands, check the advance-to-supplier policy against receivable days; if receivables stretch past the stated 45-60 days [8], ask for the buyer-wise ageing and the largest buyer's payment record.**

## Where value and cash sit
**Value sits in washed-grade realisation and in the washery's yield, not in raw tonnes.** Peers show the operating leverage: Coal India's Q4 FY26 EBITDA on revenue from operations improved to 39% from 36% [5], and Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20.8% to INR 44,179 crore with net profit up 57% to INR 6,547 crore [7]. **Capex is heavy and lumpy - washery capacity is built in million-tonne-per-year blocks, and BCCL is commissioning new washeries with a combined capacity of 7.00 million tonnes per year [10].** So size the loan to the contract, not the plant: if the borrower's offtake agreement is shorter than the loan tenor, ask for the renewal history and the buyer's linkage. **On the peer side, BCCL's October update shows production up 7% and offtake up 11%, but cumulative fiscal-year production is still negative [4]; Coal India's October output recovery drew on inventories, with a late-month slowdown flagged [7].** Rating reports on washeries and mining-services firms are undated in our file [9][11] - old, so use them for structure, not for current numbers. **The data pack gives no score for this industry in this city [D], so the call rests on first principles and peers.**

## Who to pursue, and how to grow safely
**Pursue washery operators with a written offtake from a named buyer, mining-services contractors paid per tonne moved, and transporters tied to a specific mine.** Avoid traders with no washing asset, units inside the Khara closure list [1], and any borrower whose supplier advances are funded by us without a matching buyer contract. **Structure: cash-flow-backed limits, monthly stock-and-receivable statements, and a charge on the offtake contract.** Take every month the buyer-wise sales register, the coal stock statement, and the advance-payment ledger. **If the borrower cannot show the buyer's grade-wise acceptance, ask for the weighbridge slips.**

## Early-warning signs
**Watch receivable days against the 45-60 day norm [8], stock build-up without offtake, and any pollution notice in the borrower's area [1].** If a buyer delays beyond the stated cycle, cut the drawing power before the next limit review.
watch: days cross 60 -> freeze drawing power and seek buyer confirmation
stock rises while offtake flat -> ask for weighbridge slips and buyer acceptance
any notice in borrower's area [1] -> stop fresh disbursement until compliance proof
supplier advances exceed contract terms -> reduce limit
offtake falls below contracted volume -> reprice or exit at review
